nodes.name: URL Shortener
nodes.what: Creates short links and redirects clicks
nodes.why: Shareable links with owner click counts

nodes.name: Key Range Service
nodes.what: Pre-generates and hands out unique short-code ranges
nodes.why: Lets creators assign codes without colliding

nodes.name: Link Creation Service
nodes.what: Takes long URLs and stores short-code mappings

nodes.name: Redirect Service
nodes.what: Resolves short codes to long URLs
nodes.why: Serves high-volume redirects with low latency

flags.intent: Redirect Service serves high-volume redirects with low latency with no-blocking-on-click-count via read-through-cache
flags.difference: Handler does await db.query UPDATE clicks before redirect, blocking the hot path on a synchronous DB write instead of fire-and-forget async counting, breaking p99<50ms at 10B/month; also does not fill cache after store miss.

flags.intent: Redirect Service serves high-volume redirects with low latency via read-through-cache
flags.difference: handler does cache.get then store get on miss but never fills Redirect Cache, so misses never become hits and 10B/month reads stay on the database, breaking read-through-cache low-latency design

nodes.name: Link Table (Key-Value)
nodes.why: Durable lookup by key at large scale
nodes.blurb: Durable mapping of codes to URLs

nodes.name: Redirect Cache
nodes.what: Caches hot code to URL mappings

nodes.name: Click Event Stream
nodes.blurb: Buffers click events for async counting

nodes.name: Click Aggregation Worker
nodes.what: Consumes events and aggregates click counts
nodes.why: Provides owner analytics without slowing redirects

nodes.name: Redirect Request Handler
nodes.what: Validates short code and returns 302 redirect
nodes.why: Owns low-latency hot path under 10B/month load

nodes.name: Read Through Fetcher
nodes.what: Loads missing mappings from store into cache
nodes.why: Keeps redirect fast while staying consistent

nodes.name: Click Event Publisher
nodes.why: Preserves p99 latency by moving counts async
